resources.string: "Getting started and applying settings"
"install activate LSPosed libxposed scope launcher diagnostics scan restart about help"
"First setup"

"1. Use Android 9 or later and install LSPosed with libxposed API 102 support. The current adaptation target is TikTok 47.5.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically, versionCode 2024705030).
2. Install TokAi, enable it in LSPosed, and select TikTok as its scope.
3. Completely close and reopen TikTok. Open TokAi from TikTok settings, then choose the category you want to configure. Wait for the initial scan to finish before proceeding.
4. Open Help from About at the bottom of the home page. Help is stored locally; reading and searching require no internet connection."
"The module app and settings inside TikTok"

"The TokAi launcher app shows framework connection, scan diagnostics, and About information. Its launcher icon can also be hidden. Configure features in TokAi settings inside TikTok; those settings are stored in TikTok\'s private directory.\nThe module app\'s framework connection status is separate from feature settings inside TikTok. A successful connection or completed scan does not establish that every feature has run successfully on an actual page. You can still manage the module in LSPosed after hiding its icon.\nThe module interface automatically follows the system light or dark theme, with no separate setting. Even if TikTok uses a fixed light theme, module pages follow the system. Changing theme does not alter saved settings or user-selected colors. If the host rebuilds a page following a system configuration change, existing page dismissal behavior applies."
"When changes take effect"

"Switches and saved settings notify the current TikTok process. Most features update immediately or use the new settings when you next change videos, open a page, or receive a message. Content in an editor usually must be saved before it is written.\nChanging a switch cannot restore or retract startup ads and dialogs already shown, or content already sent. After changing startup settings, completely close and reopen TikTok to check. Restart TikTok after installing or updating the module, changing its LSPosed scope, or encountering an unsupported scan result.\nDisabling the corresponding automatic feature or changing its settings cancels older tasks that have not been submitted. Check the destination page or history for requests already in TikTok\'s sending flow."
"Settings backup: import and export"
"JSON settings import export backup merge overwrite credentials restore UTF-8 local analytics"
"Export a JSON backup"

"In TokAi settings inside TikTok, open Extensions → Settings backup. Tap Export settings and save a JSON file through the system file picker. Backups include feature settings, model profiles, prompts, scope lists, component locators, and API settings supported by this version. They exclude chat/reply history, sending ledgers, runtime caches, and retry/reset commands.\nInclude local analytics data is unchecked by default. Enabling it writes retained browsing statistics, creators, topics, feature usage, association records, self-description, and feedback to the selected file. The collection switch and temporary AI interpretations are excluded.\nExport API keys is unchecked by default. Keys and custom headers, parameters, or endpoint fragments that may contain credentials are omitted by default and may need to be entered again after import. Free text, including reply bodies and prompts, is saved unchanged; check it for sensitive information entered manually. If you include keys, these fields are saved as plain text. Keep the file secure."
"Preview and import"

"Tap Choose settings file. After reading and validation, review the counts of changes, removals, and fields requiring input. Merge is the default and keeps current settings absent from the backup. Overwrite current settings recalculates the preview and removes backup-eligible feature settings absent from the file. Runtime state and sending ledgers are unaffected.
Settings are applied only after Confirm import. They take effect immediately and may change automatic reply or comment switches. Restart TikTok for items requiring Hook reinstallation. If current settings change after preview, preview again. Import does not publish uncommitted temporary settings to running features. If writing fails, it attempts to restore the original snapshot.
For a file containing local analytics, separately select Restore local analytics data and confirm to replace current analytics records. This is independent of settings merge/overwrite and does not enable collection automatically. Existing analytics remain unchanged when this is unchecked or when importing an ordinary settings backup.
Backups without keys retain current credentials only when model and endpoint identities match. Enter credentials again for a different service, account, or unverified address. System directory grants and local audio files are not transferred in JSON; you may need to select them again on another device."
"Files and cancellation"

"Only TokAi-format UTF-8 JSON is supported. Ordinary settings have a 2 MiB limit; backups containing local analytics have a 32 MiB limit. Oversized, damaged, incorrectly typed, unknown-version, or unsupported data is rejected. Closing the page or canceling an unconfirmed operation does not import settings. Explicitly confirmed writes may finish, but the closed page receives no further updates. An interrupted export may leave an incomplete file; confirm export success before using it."
"Local analytics"
"statistics reports charts usage trends topics creators photos Live motion photos long video short video feature rankings clear privacy AI model provider secondary prompt global model"
"Start recording"

"Open Extensions → Local analytics in TokAi settings inside TikTok and enable recording to begin collection. It is off by default, does not backfill past browsing, and stops adding records when disabled while keeping existing data. Data and the switch are stored in TikTok\'s private no-backup directory. Routine statistics are not uploaded. They are excluded from settings backups by default; you can explicitly include analytics on the backup page. The collection switch is not restored from backup. Up to the most recent 365 days are retained."
"What the statistics count"

"Selecting a supported feed post counts as one view; preloading does not. Consecutive duplicate callbacks for the same post count once; leaving and returning to it counts again. Ordinary photo posts and posts containing Live motion photos are counted separately; a whole motion-photo post counts once. Videos at least 5 minutes long are classified as long videos. Unrecognized content is listed separately. Completion and watch duration are not inferred.\nCreators and topics come from current post metadata; a post may have multiple topics. Feature rankings count only integrated actions or matches. They do not represent every enabled feature or successful server-side operations."
"View and clear records"

"Choose today, 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, or all retained records to see browsing trends, post-type shares, creator and topic rankings, module feature rankings, time-of-day distribution, recent records, and activity history. 7 days means today plus the previous 6 days as one range, not seven daily analyses. If you forget to request analysis on a day, later choose a range that still includes it. Report blocks initially show a compact view; tap a heading to expand charts, details, and corresponding analysis, then tap again to collapse. Clear records and confirm to delete local statistics. Clearing TikTok app data or uninstalling TikTok also deletes them. Disabling recording does not automatically delete existing statistics."
"Profiles and combined charts"

"Local analytics concern only the person using the module; they do not create multi-user profiles. Observations draw on full creator/topic distributions, content formats, encounters across days, time periods, and comparison with an equally long preceding period. The page includes a calendar, stacked content, topic treemap, creator concentration curve, weekday/time heatmap, and topic migration. Open the supporting evidence to see calculation ranges and sample limitations. These are not psychological personality scores.\nNew versions record focused, visible segments and associations with explicit post actions. Raw associations are retained for up to 30 days; old records are not reconstructed. Background and unfocused-window time is excluded, but same-window occlusion or actual attention cannot be reliably detected. Manual, automatic, and unknown sources are separate, as are entry, request, acceptance, and success stages; these cannot be directly treated as distinct task counts.\nMy purpose of use may be blank. It stays on the device and is included only in an explicitly requested analysis. Profile feedback is stored locally and does not automatically train or rewrite a profile. Clearing records deletes statistics, self-description, and feedback while keeping model settings."
"Choose the analysis model and secondary prompt"

"In the AI analysis area of Local analytics, choose a saved provider profile under Model profile. Follow global model is the default. This selection is independent of automatic replies and comments and does not change the globally active model. Explicitly selecting a saved profile does not require a global model to be enabled. If that profile is deleted, select another; the provider does not switch automatically.\nAnalysis uses the selected profile\'s endpoint, key, model, primary prompt, streaming or non-streaming response mode, reasoning effort, and other request parameters. Enter analysis-specific focus or style requirements in Secondary prompt. Leave it blank or tap Restore default secondary prompt to use the default analysis prompt. It does not modify the model\'s primary prompt or the secondary prompts for automatic replies and comments.\nFor example: “Compare changes in content types and active times over the past week and preceding period; keep conclusions concise and cite specific numbers.” The program still controls report fields, statistical definitions, and output validation. Settings cannot be edited during analysis. Saving or changing them does not automatically connect to the internet. The model selection and secondary prompt are included in ordinary settings backups."
"Request AI analysis and share"

"Only tapping Request AI analysis below the charts sends the current statistics, preceding-period and 7/30-day comparisons, combined metrics, association summaries, purpose of use, and creator/topic/feature rankings to the model selected for local analytics. Media, raw post identifiers, per-record exact times from recent records, and direct-message or comment bodies are not sent. On success, the report shows the complete selectable and copyable profile and interpretation and hides the request button. Corresponding interpretations remain available below individual charts.
Share analysis text uses the system share menu for an existing AI interpretation. Export/share report lets you choose a long PNG image or PDF, reformatting the complete report, charts, and existing AI results for the current range on a light paper background. You then choose where to share it; no new AI request is made. Export also works without AI results and marks the report as not analyzed. Reports include creator/topic rankings, recent records, and AI text, which may quote your self-description; review the content. On Android 10 and later, long images go to Pictures/TokAi and PDFs to Downloads/TokAi. On Android 9, choose a file location. Images exceeding the pixel limit prompt you to use PDF instead of cutting off later content. PDFs are limited to 64 pages; reduce the range if exceeded.
Collapsing blocks changes only the on-screen view. Exported reports are unaffected by collapsed state or theme and retain the range, collection boundaries, and generation times of existing AI results. They do not attach the database or API settings. PDFs use clear paginated images; their text cannot be selected like ordinary text PDFs. Files remain after opening the system share sheet so the receiving app can read them. Canceling recipient selection does not delete files automatically; delete them yourself when no longer needed.
Results last only on the current report page. Refreshing charts, changing range, clearing records, or changing the analysis model or secondary prompt requires new analysis so old interpretations do not accompany new charts or settings. Failed requests can be retried. Closing the page cancels an active request. Refreshing, changing range, reanalyzing, editing analysis settings, or closing also cancels image tasks not yet handed off. Data already sent to the model cannot be recalled by cancellation."
"Basic features: startup and dialogs"
"startup splash ads updates basic features"
"Reduce startup interruptions"

"Under Basic features, enable Remove startup and splash ads and Remove update prompts as needed. Each switch controls its corresponding display entry.\nCheck startup and splash ad settings on the next launch. The update switch controls TikTok\'s in-app update prompts."
"How this differs from feed filtering"

"Basic features handle startup and prompt windows. Configure ads, LIVE, photos, and other recommended content under Video filters. Disabling one entry does not automatically enable a different kind of filter."
"Interface and nine-region gestures"
"floating toolbar long press double tap quick menu copy text save media speed top tabs full screen refresh black bars camera icon"
"Organize the video interface"

"Floating toolbar provides quick actions on the current video page. Hide the camera + icon hides the bottom camera entry while preserving its layout space; disabling restores it. Hide top and bottom black bars crops the video centrally while preserving its aspect ratio. The status and navigation bars are controlled separately under Immersive full screen.\nDisable double tap to like disables TikTok\'s native double-tap like action. Block videos inserted mid-feed limits insertions from identified automatic sources while preserving refreshes, the first screen, end-of-list additions, and unknown sources."
"Assign long press or double tap actions"

"1. Open Long press actions or Double tap actions. The two gestures are configured independently.
2. Choose top left, top center, top right, middle left, center, middle right, bottom left, bottom center, or bottom right in the screen's nine-region grid.
3. Assign None, Quick menu, Copy text, Save media, Open comments, Hide/show components, Playback speed, or View finder to that region.
4. Return to the current recommended video and trigger the gesture in that region. Copy and save actions target the current post. Speed selection persists across videos until you trigger Playback speed again.
Save media uses the download method and location currently selected under Downloads. Official-download gestures first show a selection dialog and save only after confirmation. With third-party download selected, the gesture does not also perform an official download."
"Avoid conflicts with native gestures"

"Block native long press speed activation disables TikTok\'s own long-press speed entry. Block native long press gestures intercepts native long presses in all nine video regions while still executing configured module actions; taps and swipes work normally. Module-only speed control enables both interception settings automatically and restores their previous selections when disabled.\nConfigure double-tap actions together with native double-tap liking. To retain TikTok\'s original behavior, set the relevant region to None and check the corresponding interception switches."
"Top tabs, full screen, and refresh"

"Enable Hide top tabs, then select the names to hide under Configure top tabs. If the tab list has been loaded, keep at least one top tab. Before the list is available, enter names separated by commas.\nUnder Immersive full screen, choose separately whether to hide the status and navigation bars. Confirm home feed refresh asks for confirmation before a repeated tap on Home refreshes the feed."
"Video filters: recommended content"
"filter recommendation feed ads nearby ads LIVE recommendation cards mini games long video low likes photos text duration interruption"
"Filter by type"

"First enable filtering, then choose ads, LIVE, recommendation cards, mini games, or photo posts. Native cards include TikTok\'s general recommendation cards; mini game filtering includes identified native mini game cards. A post matching any enabled condition is filtered using the flags and information currently provided by TikTok.\nKeep the original list if all items are filtered is on by default. If every item on a page would be removed, the original page is retained and that filtering pass is skipped. This protection may explain occasionally seeing content that matches your filters."
"Set duration and like thresholds"

"Filter long videos removes explicit long-video types and posts exceeding Maximum duration (seconds), which defaults to 120 seconds.\nFilter short videos removes posts below Minimum duration (seconds). For example, with a minimum of 10, videos known to be shorter than 10 seconds are removed; videos exactly 10 seconds long are not removed by this condition.\nEnter the actual count under Minimum likes (0 for no limit). For example, 100 removes posts known to have fewer than 100 likes; 0 disables the like threshold. Unknown duration or like data alone does not trigger the corresponding threshold filter."
"Filter by text"

"Enter Blocked keywords separated by English commas, Chinese commas, or newlines; leave blank to disable. Readable post descriptions, music titles, creator names, and other text are checked. Any keyword can match, and English matching is case-insensitive.\nFor example: ads,shopping. After changing the list, observe newly loaded recommendations. This feature is independent of the target scopes and keyword filters for automatic replies and comments."
"Downloads: methods, folders, and third-party GET"
"official third-party save media save location download folder watermark naming response JSON TXT GET APPID app_id id url parameters headers signature MD5"
"Choose a method and save location"

"1. Turn on Enable download menu.
2. Select Official download or Third-party download under Download method. They are mutually exclusive; only the current method's settings are shown. Previously entered settings for the other method are retained when switching.
3. Open Save location and choose and grant access to a directory through the system folder picker, or choose Restore default location. Official and third-party downloads share this location.
4. Start saving from a post's long-press download entry, the module download menu, or an assigned Save media gesture. For third-party downloads, the parsing API is requested first. Media types and source fields from your selected download fields are shown, and media downloads only after confirmation. There is no fallback to official download. The third-party Save all media directly switch is off by default; enabling it saves all configured download fields after successful parsing and skips selection. The two methods store their identically named switches independently.
5. Official-download gestures first group items as photos, animated videos, motion photos, videos, or audio, showing only types and counts present in the post. In photos, animated videos, or motion photos, save the current item, multiple selections, or all items. Multiple animated videos retain their original photo-post indices. Back goes up one level; Cancel does not download. A motion-photo flag without an animated source shows the reason after you tap Save. Audio uses the post's existing original sound or music source.
6. Official download's Save all media directly is off by default. When enabled, gestures skip selection and directly save the video or all photos. Disabling it restores categories, multiple selection, and motion-photo options. Both behaviors use the same naming and save location.
Reselect the folder if its grant expires or it is deleted. On Android 9, using default public directories also requires TikTok storage permission. Module-managed official media defaults to Movies/TokAi, Pictures/TokAi, or Music/TokAi by type. Third-party post packages default to Download/TokAi. Fully native TikTok saves use TikTok's own location behavior."
"Official downloads and filename templates"

"Custom filename lets the module save videos, photos, and audio using a template. Available fields are #author# for creator, #desc# for description, #aid# for post ID, #date# for date, #index# for index, and #ext# for extension.\nExample: #author#_#aid#_#index#.#ext#.\nRemove download restrictions uses existing, readable media sources for the post. Download photos or videos without watermark uses identified watermark-free resources; it cannot create a watermark-free file when no such source exists. Available media depend on the post and API adaptation."
"Actions in the download menu"

"With Official download selected, the menu offers available native saving, audio download, playback-source video saving, identified watermark-free video download, or photo saving, according to the current post. A custom directory replaces native saving with saving the current post to that directory. Only media actions with an actual source in the post are shown.\nWith Third-party download selected and Save all media directly disabled, the same category and multiple-selection dialogs as official downloads are shown. Types come from photos, videos, animated videos, audio, or files parsed from configured download fields. Each item shows its source field and original index, and supports saving one item, multiple items, or a whole type. Naming still uses third-party naming fields. Selected files are saved together with a post-information TXT file. Back and Cancel do not download media. Copy post source data puts the current post model on the clipboard; it copies readable data, not downloaded media."
"View progress or cancel"

"Open Downloads → Download tasks to see official media and third-party post packages saved by TokAi. The page shows queued, downloading, saving, and final states. It shows progress when the file size is available, otherwise downloaded byte counts. Fully native TikTok downloads remain managed by TikTok.\nTap Cancel download on a task to stop a queued or active save. Canceling an active task first disconnects the request and cleans up its incomplete files before releasing the task. Failed or canceled third-party packages clean up files created in that attempt without deleting existing files. Closing the tasks page does not stop downloads; reopen it to continue viewing.\nOfficial media and third-party packages share 2 active slots and 16 waiting slots. Duplicate tasks are not submitted again. Each task has at most 30 minutes from execution start, including third-party parsing and saving all files. Individual media files still have a 512 MB limit. The page retains active tasks and the most recent 50 completed records during the current TikTok session."
"Configure a general GET request and arbitrary parameters"

"Enter a full HTTP or HTTPS API address for GET request. Use {url} for the post share link, including within the path if needed. The module extracts the link from shared text and replaces the placeholder with its encoded value.
Example: https://example.com/parse?id=123&link={url}
This example has parameters id and link. After saving the GET address, Request parameters automatically shows parameter names from it; no refresh button is needed. Add, delete, or rename them freely, choosing a fixed value or the post link for each value. Delete all parameters if none are needed, remove APPID if unnecessary, and retain exact names such as ID, apikey, or token as specified by the API documentation. The module does not supply these business parameters automatically.
The parameter editor encodes values. Do not use a complete shared caption as a fixed post link. An address without {url} is requested as entered, suitable for APIs that do not need a post link."
"What to put in request headers"

"Request headers are names and values sent with HTTP requests for provider identification, format requirements, or source information. Follow the provider's documentation and enter a JSON object. Quote both names and values with double quotes; values must be strings. Use {} if there are no special requirements.
Example: {"Authorization":"Bearer YOUR_KEY","Accept":"application/json"}
Authorization carries credentials; retain one space after Bearer. Accept specifies the desired response format. For APIs using X-API-Key, enter {"X-API-Key":"YOUR_KEY"}. Headers and the apikey URL parameter are different locations; use the one the API requires.
Do not enter Host, Content-Length, or Connection, and do not insert newlines in values. Adding headers does not mean an API requires them. Incorrect authentication commonly results in 401 or 403."
"Signing method"

"Choose No signature if the API does not require signing. To use the provided MD5 rule, select the corresponding signing method and enter Signing secret and Signature header. The default header name is Sign.\nThe current rule sorts GET query parameters by name, joins parameterName=encodedValue pairs with &, directly appends the signing secret, computes lowercase MD5, and puts it in the specified header. Value encoding corresponds to PHP http_build_query. Signing mode does not allow duplicate parameter names.\nThis is a specific rule, not a universal signing algorithm for all APIs. If your provider requires a different algorithm, changing the header name alone will not adapt it."
"Parse responses, select fields, and name files"

"1. Paste returned JSON or TXT into Sample response, or tap Test GET, enter shared text, and make one request to use its actual response as the sample. Testing accesses the API and may consume its quota.
2. Under Download fields, select fields containing media links. Example fields include data.video, data.video_raw, data.images, data.cover, data.audio, and data.author.avatar. Select only the files you need. Links in array fields are saved, with duplicate links removed.
3. Under Filename fields, choose creator names, post IDs, or other information, such as data.author.nickname and data.id. Valid fields are combined in order, empty fields skipped, and automatic names used if no name can be obtained. Media names also include an index and field identifier; invalid filename characters are sanitized.
4. Actual saving parses the live response again and saves media with a TXT file of other organized information in the post package. Unselected links may still be written into the TXT as information.
TXT can use fields such as Title: Content or Video: https://...; standalone links go under links. Web pages, empty responses, or selected fields without links produce a failure notice. A single operation supports at most 64 media files. m3u8 and mpd playlists are not currently supported."
"Autoplay and playback speed"
"auto scroll next previous smart direction pause comments speed 0.75 4x module-only speed exclusive manual priority interaction automation"
"Continuous viewing"

"Automatically scroll to the next video switches after the current video finishes. Smart swipe direction follows your most recent manual swipe direction when enabled; otherwise it uses a fixed next-video direction.\nPause scrolling while comments are open suspends automatic switching while the comment list is expanded, making reading and typing easier. It controls switching and does not pause the video itself."
"Automatic and manual speed"

"Playback speed offers seven choices: 0.75x, 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 2x, 3x, and 4x. The default is 2x; manual numeric entry is no longer used. Previously saved custom values are displayed as the nearest choice; for example, 2.75 displays as 3x. Selecting a choice saves the new value. Automatic playback speed applies the selected speed when changing posts.
Playback speed in gestures or the quick menu is a persistent toggle. Enabling it uses the speed selected here, retained after releasing the gesture, changing videos, or returning to the foreground. Trigger it again to restore 1x; later videos also stay at 1x. Changing the selected speed updates an enabled gesture speed. Disabling the module releases the manual selection.
With Module-only speed control, the module initially maintains 1x. Long press switches between the selected speed and the module's 1x; native speed requests no longer become playback targets. Manual changes take priority. Automatic playback speed is temporarily unavailable but its previous setting is kept. Both native long-press interception settings appear enabled and cannot be disabled, with Enabled by module-only speed control shown. Disabling this mode restores their previous selections.
You can also address long-press conflicts by enabling Block native long press gestures separately under Interface. A switching notice indicates the selected playback target. Unconfirmed actual-speed information remains in debug logs; judge actual speed from playback."
"Open interaction automation"

"Interaction automation manages the automation master switch, automatic likes, automatic follows, and Stop now. Configure the details of automatic replies, automatic comments, and Streak renewal in their respective home-page categories."
"Automation switches, previews, and history"
"interaction automation like follow stop now confirmation floating notice countdown limits history cancel"
"Enable and stop now"

"Under Autoplay → Interaction automation, enable the master switch, then automatic likes or follows. Automatic likes only target the currently displayed post if not already liked. Automatic follows use TikTok\'s native follow flow.\nEnabling automatic replies, comments, or Streak renewal also enables the interaction master switch. The master switch controls automatic likes, follows, and Streak renewal. Automatic replies and their direct-chat, group-chat, and comment-reply channels are controlled by Enable automatic replies; automatic comments use their own switch. Disabling the interaction master switch does not pause them. Disable the corresponding feature or use Stop now.\nStop now turns off the master switch, automatic likes, automatic follows, automatic replies, receiving comment replies, automatic comments, and Streak renewal, and cancels automatic tasks not yet submitted. Check actual results for requests already submitted to TikTok."
"Limit quantity and frequency"

"Direct-chat, group-chat, and comment replies share the daily maximum reply count and per-user interval. Automatic comments have separate daily maximum and per-creator interval settings. All default to 0, meaning unlimited. Daily counts reset by the device\'s local calendar day. Intervals use UIDs; changing the same person\'s nickname does not create a fresh quota.\nTarget scope, keyword conditions, daily quota, and interval must all be satisfied. If an enabled feature does nothing, first check these conditions and the signed-in account."
"Sending and history"

"Set a delay from 2 to 3600 seconds under Sending and history in automatic replies or comments. Direct-chat, group-chat, and comment replies share delay, floating notice, and save-history settings. After enabling Floating notice, set a notice timeout from 2 to 120 seconds. An unsaved timeout defaults to 3 seconds; previously saved values remain unchanged. A pending-send notice appears after generation. Tap it to inspect original and generated content and send now or cancel; long press to cancel. Submission happens automatically when the countdown ends; individual confirmation is not mandatory.\nAutomatic replies have a separate blue circular floating notice shared by direct chats, group chats, and comment replies. Automatic comments keep the teal circular notice. Both can appear together, be dragged separately, and remember their positions. Tap to inspect the target and body; long press cancels unsubmitted tasks. Opening details pauses the countdown and offers Send now or Cancel. Submitted or unknown-result tasks are checked for status without sending again. Automatic comments also show generation, publishing, and retry progress.\nWith history saving enabled, reply or comment history shows the target, time, input, output, model, and status, and can be cleared. Comment replies appear in Reply history with their source identified. History saving and model context turns are separate settings."
"Understand result states"

"Sent successfully means the corresponding native success result was received. Submitted means the request entered the sending flow but its outcome is unconfirmed; it does not by itself mean success. Failed and Canceled indicate failure and cancellation before submission, respectively.\nIf the network is delayed or callbacks are missing, first check the actual chat or post comments to avoid duplicates. Successful text generation, speech synthesis, and actual publication are distinct stages."
"Automatic replies: direct chats, groups, and comments"
"fixed AI keywords random reply scope allowlist blocklist following followers strangers UID @me images speech comment replies foreground rescan baseline deduplication"
"Choose reply content"

"1. Turn on Enable automatic replies and confirm the intended TikTok account is signed in. Enable Receive direct chats, Receive group chats, or Receive comment replies as needed.
2. In Reply mode, choose fixed content, AI model, keyword rules, or random content.
3. Open Reply content. Enter a fixed body in fixed mode; choose a saved provider profile under Model profile and enter a secondary prompt in AI mode; add keywords and corresponding replies in keyword mode; add multiple candidate replies in random mode.
4. AI mode supports Media recognition. Recognize images is on by default and Recognize videos is off; all three receiving channels share them. Both require a model supporting image input because videos are supplied as extracted frames. Fixed, keyword, and random modes do not read or request media. Switching modes retains the switches you selected.
Direct chats, group chats, and comment replies share the selected reply mode, model profile, reply content, and AI secondary prompt. Keyword rules match received text in order, ignoring English case; the first matching rule supplies the reply. No reply is sent for unmatched rules or empty content. Random mode chooses one configured candidate.
Newly received supported text messages are processed. AI mode with image recognition can process supported image messages. With recognition off, image-only direct or group messages are skipped; image messages with real text may receive a text-only reply. If recognition is on but an image address is missing or unsupported, the entire message is skipped rather than using an empty-image request. Your own messages, old history, and unsupported message types do not trigger ordinary automatic replies.
Direct and group chats can be processed whenever TikTok is running and receives new messages; the specific chat page need not be open. Restart TikTok after updating the module to apply a new receiving method.
Image reading for AI replies has a 60-second limit. After the configured reply delay, queuing and execution each have independent 120-second budgets. Execution includes images, AI requests, and audio preparation. Disabling replies, changing relevant settings, or switching accounts cancels older unsubmitted tasks. Late results are not sent after timeout. Requests already in preview or TikTok's sending flow follow their existing confirmation states."
"Set direct-chat scope"

"Receive direct chats is on by default. Open Direct-chat scope and choose all, allowlist, or blocklist. An allowlist accepts selected relationships or UIDs; a blocklist excludes them. Combine Following, Followers, Strangers, and Specific users as needed. Matching either a relationship or UID matches the list.\nMessage filtering is separate from the target list: unrestricted, include keywords, or exclude keywords. Separate keywords with English commas and choose sender or message-body matching. Any matching keyword counts. Include mode requires at least one usable keyword and matching field.\nRefresh Following and followers for the current account to view actual UIDs. If loading fails, relationships are unknown, or the account changes, do not infer confirmed relationships from display names."
"Set group-chat scope"

"Receive group chats is off by default. Enable it, then open Group-chat scope. Choose all groups, a group allowlist, or a blocklist, then Everyone, Specific members, or Only @me.\nGroup scope matches group conversation identifiers. Specific members can select loaded group members or accept a UID or nickname; prefer UIDs. Only @me checks real mention markers in TikTok messages. Merely typing the same name in the body may not trigger it.\nGroup conditions are independent of direct-chat follow relationships and message filtering. Both group allowlists and blocklists accept manually entered conversation IDs, so they can be configured without a cached group list. Alternatively, open an existing group in TikTok first, then select it from the loaded list."
"Enable voice replies"

"Voice replies first generates a body according to the chosen reply mode, then synthesizes audio using the source currently selected under Extensions → Text to speech settings. It applies to enabled direct-chat, group-chat, and comment-reply channels.\nOnly audio is submitted, without also sending generated text. Changing filters clears only this source's voice cache and retains the selected ID.
Pages request 20 items. Load more appends using Breeze's has_more, cursor, or page number, retaining at most 200 items per filter set. The heading shows loaded count and continuation state. Later-page failures, stalled pagination, or a local budget limit retain loaded results and the current selection; narrow the search if needed. A cache may be partial browsing results, never labeled a complete account catalog. Model catalogs and each voice page have a 45-second module wait budget. Closing or changing conditions cancels old requests and rejects stale writes. Breeze catalogs require a valid key; anonymous HTTP reachability does not verify an account catalog."
"Voice tags, search, and Chinese name translations"

"Narrow the catalog with tags first. Breeze offers language, category, multiple genders/ages/tones, accent, unspecified accent, source, favorites, custom tags, scope, search, and sorting. Fish offers multiple voice/name languages, tags, author, license flags, scope, search, and sorting, without borrowing Breeze\'s gender enumeration. A specific accent and unspecified accent are mutually exclusive. Popularity sorting is only for Breeze\'s system scope. Tags are platform metadata and do not guarantee quality. Public scope without language, tag, search, or other filters prompts you to set conditions first.\nTyping inside the list immediately filters loaded Chinese translations, original names, IDs, and tags without requesting the catalog. Search all voices queries the API with the same tag conditions. After changing language, tags, key, or address, the old cache is no longer treated as current results. Quick voices use only caches matching the filter scope.\nTranslate names uses the currently active text AI to translate at most 100 uncached names per request and may incur text-model charges. Only original voice names are sent, not voice IDs, keys, chats, or tag descriptions. Labels appear as Chinese translation (original name). Original names and voice IDs remain unchanged. Failures retain originals; successful batches are cached locally. Closing or changing conditions can cancel. Opening the list does not automatically translate names."
"Breeze Blue speech instructions"

"Under Language and expression, enter reading instructions in the same language as the text. Optimize instructions explicitly asks Breeze to optimize the current draft. The optimization API receives only instructions and optional language, not the text to synthesize, and does not translate instructions. Results first become an inspectable, editable draft and apply only after saving. Opening or saving settings does not automatically optimize.\nThe optimization endpoint requires nonempty instructions of at most 1000 characters. This limits optimization, not ordinary synthesis instructions. Closing the editor, changing the draft, or switching sources stops the operation and rejects late results.\nSpeed ranges from 0.5 to 2 and volume from 0.01 to 2; both default to 1. Volume is a linear multiplier. Guidance ranges from 1 to 10, default 1, and speaker boost is off by default. Nonempty instructions with guidance greater than 1 disable boost. Otherwise, enabled boost makes effective guidance 1 while instructions still apply. Currently inactive controls are hidden with the reason shown; saved values are retained."
"Breeze Blue advanced settings"

"Audio output supports MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, or Opus. Choose sample rate and bitrate by format or manually enter values such as mp3_44100_128 and wav_48000. Bitrate is in kbps; an explicit bitrate requires a sample rate first. WAV/FLAC carry no bitrate. Default mp3 uses the native 24000 Hz mono source. Increasing output sample rate does not increase source bandwidth.\nGeneration return mode supports complete synchronous audio, HTTP streaming, and background generation. HTTP streaming supports MP3/WAV only and still waits for a complete file before previewing or sending; comments are not published while generation is ongoing. Background generation POSTs a task only once, polls that same service\'s task status, and downloads from that service\'s task /audio endpoint after completion. It does not follow download_url or generate again on each poll.\nSpeech instructions, language codes, guidance, and boost use Breeze\'s own API. Blank language omits the field and does not inherit the reference voice\'s language. There are no MiniMax pitch, mixing, effects, watermark, or URL/Hex settings. Raw PCM has no container and is unavailable in current sending entries; choose WAV. Word timestamps, realtime-session control, and ASR are not included in audio-only sending settings."
"Breeze Blue API and backup boundaries"

"Default accounts have a 1000-character text limit; approved accounts can reach 2000. The module keeps the complete body without truncating or splitting requests. The service may segment and merge under its own rules, without guaranteeing that every character was spoken. Existing synthesis deadlines and the 20 MiB audio budget still apply. Canceling or timing out a background task does not prove server generation stopped or no charge occurred.\nEndpoint, model, voice, voice filters, return mode, and parameters participate independently in backups, with keys omitted by default. Old keys are restored only within the same service boundary; catalog caches are not exported. The new HTTP layer does not automatically generate again. Existing comment-audio retries, text fallback, and automatic-reply failure behavior are retained.\nThis description does not claim verification of real-account synthesis, phone decoding, audio quality, or TikTok publication. See version records for specific tests and final-package evidence. Based on the Breeze official TTS guide: https://docs.breezeblue.ai/guides/text-to-speech; native API: https://api.breeze.blue/openapi.json."
"Configure Fish Audio"

"Select Fish Audio to browse public voices first. For synthesis, preview, or My voices, enter its separate key under API settings. The default address is https://api.fish.audio. Enter only the key itself. Speech engine corresponds to the model request header. Fixed candidates are s2.1-pro (default), s2.1-pro-free, s2-pro, s1, and drama-3. Invalid generic model refresh and manual engine entry are not offered. Candidates do not establish account permissions or quota.
Voice and engine are separate. Under Voice → Voice source, choose a single voice, multiple speakers, or reference audio. A single voice can be selected from the library or entered as reference_id. Blank uses the service's default voice. Changing modes retains their respective settings without rewriting text or prompts.
Under Voice → Voice library, set language, tags, or voice search before Refresh voices. Chinese is the default. Each page requests 20 items, with subsequent pages loaded manually through Load more. An unsaved scope defaults to Public; saved scopes are retained. Public catalogs allow anonymous reading; if a key is entered, requests use it. My voices belongs to the active workspace and requires a valid key. Synthesis and preview still require a valid key.
The module selects only type=tts and state=trained results and advances pagination by raw entries. Public-library search windows and inexact totals are normal browsing states; results within a window are not the entire library. Later-page failure, repetition, unknown continuation, or reaching the local 200-item browsing budget retains loaded voices and the current selection. Narrow search and refresh if needed."
"Fish Audio multiple speakers and reference audio"

"In multiple-speaker mode, add voices in order. The same ID may serve different speakers. Write labels such as <|speaker:0|>Hello.<|speaker:1|>Hi there. in the body yourself. Numbers correspond to list order and start at 0. S1 does not support multiple speakers. Out-of-range numbers, incorrect labels, or missing required labels show a notice. The module does not insert labels or rewrite dialogue automatically.
In reference-audio mode, tap Add reference audio → Choose audio file. WAV/MP3/FLAC are supported. Enter the speaker number and exact Sample transcript actually spoken in the audio, save the sample, then Save and use. Each speaker may have multiple samples. Numbers are consecutive from 0. Bodies with multiple groups use the corresponding labels; S1 allows one group only.
The official recommendation is 10–30 seconds of clear speech. This is quality advice, not a module duration cap. Limits of 8 speakers/groups, 4 samples per group, and 8 MiB combined reference audio are module editing and media budgets, not claimed Fish API maxima.
Media are first copied into the current host's local directory. During synthesis, original bytes and exact transcripts are sent to Fish as references in MessagePack binary. Audio is not stored as Base64 in settings backups, and no remote voice model is created or trained. Canceling unsaved edits cleans up unused copies imported during that edit."
"Fish Audio reading and advanced settings"

"Speed ranges from 0.5 to 2, default 1. Volume ranges from -20 to 20 dB, default 0, representing decibel gain rather than another provider's multiplier. Loudness normalization is on by default. When ineffective with S1, its control is hidden and the request omits the field while retaining the saved value.
Audio output supports MP3/WAV/Ogg-Opus. MP3 offers 32000/44100 Hz and 64/128/192 kbps. WAV offers 8000/16000/24000/32000/44100 Hz without bitrate. Opus uses 48000 Hz with automatic or 24/32/48/64 kbps bitrate, sent as bps. Sample rate may use the API default. Audio is fixed mono and used only after the complete file is available. Raw PCM has no container and is unavailable here; choose WAV.
Native generation parameters are retained: temperature and Top P default to 0.7, latency normal, chunk length 300, minimum length 50, maximum audio tokens per chunk 1024, repetition penalty 1.2, previous-context association on, early-stop threshold 1, and quality protection off. The native OpenAPI normal/300 defaults are used, not another guide's balanced/200. Chunking is service-side behavior, not module truncation of the body.
Text normalization is on by default. When on, leave language blank/auto or enter a tag such as zh-CN. It affects number/date reading, not voice or accent. Turning it off hides language and omits that field from audio-only requests while retaining its saved value. This feature does not request timestamps. S2 uses square-bracket expression labels, S1 its fixed parenthesized labels, and Drama 3 its own natural-language and paired labels. Write them yourself in the body; there is no automatic conversion."
"Fish Audio pronunciation dictionaries"

"Language and pronunciation → Pronunciation dictionaries (JSON) accepts at most 3 dictionaries of the same kind: all published id/version references or all inline items, without mixing. References require exact versions, not latest. The service may skip missing dictionaries; successful synthesis does not prove a dictionary was applied.\nInline example: [{\"items\":[{\"key\":\"Kubernetes\",\"value\":\"K UW2 B ER0 N EH1 T IY0 Z\",\"case_sensitive\":false}]}]. Each dictionary permits at most 5000 items, keys of 1–256 characters, and values of 1–1024 characters. Values are pronunciation notation: CMU Arpabet for English and tone-number pinyin for Chinese. They are not arbitrary replacement text or automatic IPA conversion. Do not add phoneme_start/phoneme_end markers yourself."
"Fish Audio API and backup boundaries"

"General parameters and speaker-ID arrays can be backed up, with keys omitted by default. Local reference audio, paths, and transcripts are neither exported nor injectable from backups. Existing valid local media bindings are retained; import files again after restoring on another device. Old keys are restored only within the same service boundary and never borrowed from another source. Catalog caches are not exported.\nThe module retains complete text and generated audio without applying Breeze\'s character limit, splitting text, transcoding, or remuxing locally. The selected engine, account, existing synthesis deadline, 20 MiB audio budget, and sending entry still impose their own requirements. The new HTTP layer does not automatically repeat generation. Existing comment-audio retries, text fallback, and automatic-reply failure policies remain unchanged.\nOnly /v1/tts text to audio is handled here, not ASR, model training/publication management, or word timestamps. Real-account synthesis, audio quality, phone decoding, and TikTok publication are not claimed as verified. Version records separately provide local-test evidence. Based on the official Fish TTS guide: https://docs.fish.audio/features/text-to-speech; native API: https://api.fish.audio/openapi.json."
"Generated formats and sending original files"

"Comments directly use files generated by the source, without local transcoding or remuxing. MiniMax AAC is an experimental API option. A server refusal reports an error rather than silently switching to MP3. Third-party, Breeze Blue, and Fish Audio results are likewise handled according to the actual audio file.\nExtensions are detected from content: ADTS AAC uses .aac, MPEG-4 audio .m4a, Ogg/Opus .ogg, and WAV .wav. Renaming an extension does not change encoding. The returned valid audio file is used as-is. No new 30-second truncation is added to comments. Direct/group chats retain existing host-sending handling."
"System engine settings"

"Under API settings, Speech engine accepts the package name of an installed device text-to-speech engine. Blank uses the system default. Speech language uses a language tag such as zh-CN. The device must have installed data supporting the selected language.\nSpeed and Pitch under Reading settings default to 1 and accept 0.5 to 2. Out-of-range or invalid input shows a notice and is not saved. Old settings display their actual effective values consistently with preview and synthesis; opening the page does not rewrite them. A system engine may first need initialization or voice-data download in Android text-to-speech settings. Text length must still meet that engine\'s requirements. These system values are not used in third-party requests after switching sources."
"Configure synthesis GET and parameters"

"Enter an HTTP or HTTPS address under Synthesis GET. Use {text} for the body to synthesize and {voice} for the selected voice ID. Placeholders may appear in parameter values or paths and are encoded and replaced at runtime.
Current example: http://www.yx520.ltd/API/wzzyypromax/api.php?voice={voice}&apikey=YOUR_KEY&text={text}
Synthesis parameters lets you add or delete parameters, rename them, and select fixed values, synthesis text, or the chosen voice. APIs may use names such as id, speaker, or token. Remove unnecessary apikey or voice parameters. Parameter display updates automatically after saving GET.
Enter Synthesis headers as a JSON object with string values following provider documentation; use {} if unnecessary. These settings are stored separately even though they use the same editor as download GET. Download signing settings are not automatically applied to speech APIs."
"Sample responses and advanced voice settings"

"Synthesis sample response and Audio URL field under API settings use the same response parsing approach as third-party downloads to preview and select audio links in JSON/TXT. Existing settings remain saved and effective.
Advanced voice settings centralizes list GET, voice refresh, list headers, list/ID/name fields, and samples. Main synthesis headers, sample responses, and audio URL fields stay under API settings and are stored independently of list settings.
APIs may directly return decodable audio or an audio URL inside JSON or TXT.
Example: {"code":"200","url":"https://example.com/voice.mp3"}; enter url as the field. For a link under data.audio_url, enter data.audio_url. Blank attempts common audio fields. Specify an exact path when multiple candidates exist or detection fails.
The linked file must be real audio. Web pages, error notices, or undecodable files cannot be used as speech. Text responses have a 2 MiB limit and audio a 20 MiB limit."
"Request voice lists separately"

"Voice list GET is independent of the synthesis address. Enter a full request address, including any query parameters required by the API. The module adds none automatically and has no separate voice-list parameter editor. Configure headers under Advanced voice settings → Voice list headers. Refresh voices requests and parses the list, then select a voice. Its ID replaces {voice} in the main API; the name is display-only.
Current example: https://www.yx520.ltd/API/wzzyypromax/ys.php. For a TXT line such as “1. 叶修”, the ID is 1 and display name 叶修. The list count comes from the actual response. For TXT, leave the list, ID, and name JSON field paths in Advanced voice settings blank.
JSON example: {"data":{"voices":[{"id":"1","name":"叶修"}]}}. Enter data.voices for the list field, id for voice ID, and name for voice name. ID/name paths are relative to each list item. Common formats may also use blank paths for automatic detection.
Paste a response into Advanced voice settings → Voice list sample to check parsing offline. Without a list API, enter the ID manually under Voice. Refresh and reselect after changing an API or field. Closing settings cancels ongoing list requests and previews."
"Sending duration and troubleshooting"

"Automatic voice comments, voice comment replies, and manual # comment text to speech do not impose a module duration cap based on the host recorder\'s 30-second setting and do not truncate text or audio. Network synthesis does not inherit system-engine text-length limits. System synthesis still follows its engine requirements; third-party, MiniMax, Breeze Blue, and Fish Audio follow their own API requirements. The complete body is synthesized and complete audio passed to the host. Publication depends on TikTok\'s actual validation. Automatic direct/group-chat voice replies retain the module entry\'s 120-second limit. Comment recording-file replacement retains that module entry\'s 30-second limit; it is not a verified host-upload maximum.\nShared synthesis no longer has a 120-second duration cap. Audio must still be decodable and no larger than 20 MiB, and request or synthesis timeouts still fail. Successful preview establishes only synthesis and playback, not sending, which also requires adaptation of the corresponding TikTok entry, a valid account state, and a working network.\nFor missing sound, check system-engine language, API keys, selected voice, audio URL fields, and returned files. For 401/403, usually check authentication. For missing voice lists, check the separate address and JSON paths; TXT lists should have no JSON paths. After 3 consecutive confirmed audio failures, automatic comments fall back to the full body as text, still subject to TikTok publication validation. Failed automatic voice replies do not fall back to text."

"Global debugging and logs"

"Open About → Debugging and logs. One global switch controls both module and LSPosed logging. When off, it retains feature state, root-operation start/final states, required decisions, brief exceptions, and completeness notes. When on, it adds detailed stages, child operations, settings snapshots and selections, Hook types/timings, and stack traces. High-frequency duplicates are still summarized. Correlate causes, progress, and outcomes with trace_id and assess them against evidence and completeness lists. Comments, direct messages, AI bodies, and credentials are not logged.\nThe page supports category filtering, keyword search, entry and formatted-JSON viewing, copying an entry, refreshing, clearing, and export. It displays the latest 128K characters. Counts reflect matching log entries in the current segment, not deduplicated cumulative business events. Copy uses current filters; export includes up to 2 MiB of fully retained logs regardless of filters. Logs rotate at capacity; rate limits and truncation are marked. Disabling debugging does not remove old detail. Clear logs before reproducing to see only new records. Clearing does not cancel operations or rebuild the process session; later results are still logged. Reading host logs from the standalone module page requires TikTok to be running. Export module-process logs separately exports the module\'s own records."
"Missing settings or features that do not take effect"

"1. Check the installed TikTok package name, version, and internal build number. Current rules target only TikTok 47.5.3 / 2024705030. Other builds require adaptation.
2. In LSPosed, confirm the module is enabled and TikTok is selected in its scope. Fully terminate TikTok, then reopen it.
3. Check framework connection and scan diagnostics in the module app, and configure features in TokAi under TikTok settings. Module-app diagnostics are not feature switches.
4. Enable one feature at a time and trigger it on its applicable page. Missing scan targets, multiple candidates, or failed relationship validation may disable a feature. A method is not arbitrarily chosen to continue.
5. Check startup switches on the next launch, recommendation filters on newly loaded content, and gestures on the current recommended video. Version spoofing cannot fix version adaptation."
"Failed downloads or missing files"

"Check Enable download menu, the current method, share link, API response status, and selected download fields. After changing APIs, update GET, test an actual response, and reselect fields. If the third-party response is a web page, use the actual API\'s final address. Download-parsing GET does not follow redirects automatically.\nConfirm the save folder exists and its permission is still valid. Reselecting the folder fixes some permission problems. Third-party files default to post directories in Download/TokAi, with an information TXT. When third-party download is selected, gesture saving also uses it; gestures cannot bypass incorrect third-party settings."
"Automatic replies or comments do not trigger"

"Check Enable automatic replies and its Receive direct chats, Receive group chats, and Receive comment replies sub-options, or the automatic-comment switch. Check for empty fixed content; whether the profile selected under Reply content/Comment content → Model profile is saved and still exists; whether a global profile is enabled when Follow global model is selected; whether chat or post scopes include the target; correct keywords and matching fields; and daily quota or same-UID interval limits. Comment replies require both parent and receiving switches and are not controlled by the interaction master switch.
Refresh following/follower data before using relationship lists. For groups, check conversation IDs, members, and genuine @ markers. Old messages, your own messages, and unsupported types do not trigger new-message automatic replies.
First enabling comment replies only establishes a starting point. Subsequent processing requires foreground TikTok and new replies verifiable as responses to your comments. Image-only comments require AI mode, image recognition, and the actual attached images. Unverifiable original comment text or target relationships are skipped. With history enabled, open Automatic replies → Sending and history → Reply history for outcomes identified as comment replies. Submitted but unconfirmed requests are not resent automatically.
With sending history on, distinguish generation failure, submitted, and sent successfully. Comment records also show audio/text delivery. Details show recorded causes, stages, and queue/media/generation/sending times. Missing data in older records is not invented. Direct-message queue expiry and generation timeout are logged separately.
Ordinary automatic comments and direct messages save a sending reservation before calling the host. Failed persistence or a full ledger stops sending. Submitted and unknown-result deduplication records survive restarts. Timeouts or late failures do not automatically resend. For voice, check shared speech settings. Automatic comments fall back to text after 3 confirmed consecutive voice failures, but not while a submitted result is unconfirmed."
"Model or third-party API errors"

"First test short text and check the complete address, protocol, key, model name, or voice ID. 401/403 usually indicates authentication or permissions; 429 usually quota or rate limits. For timeouts, check connectivity and service responsiveness. Header JSON values must be strings.
If text works but images fail, confirm visual support, then inspect media count, sizes, and actual image-request records. Sampled video frames contain no audio. Prompt changes cannot make a model hear audio that was not uploaded.
GET parameters come from the saved address. Correct parameter names in GET or its editor; no parameter-name refresh is needed. Voice refresh retrieves the voice list, not hidden provider parameter requirements.
A failed MiniMax refresh retains the old list and shows sanitized authentication, rate-limit, balance, permission, or format reasons, not raw server error bodies. Advanced candidates show incompatibility reasons and are still validated on selection. Advanced capabilities of unknown manually entered models are unverified. On settings home, search MiniMax, voice, API Key, save folder, or watermark removal to see paths and open the corresponding page."
"Hidden controls or unknown send outcomes"

"If buttons disappear, first disable the component-hiding master switch, restore opacity, or delete a custom parent-container rule. Hiding the camera + icon may leave its original touch area.\nIf a sending notice shows only Submitted or a Streak result is unknown, check the chat or comments before retrying. Stopping a feature cancels only unsubmitted tasks. Clearing local history or records does not delete content already sent.\nWhen reporting problems, include module version, actual TikTok version, feature name, trigger page, relevant switches, and sanitized error information. Do not include full API keys."
